_comment: Original, IP-free assets. Characters are generic archetypes described purely by appearance; no real people, shows, teams, or trademarks are referenced. Jerseys are PLAIN and crest-free (a consistent team crest + numbers will be applied as a decal in Unity). meshy-6 + HD textures for realistic humans; rig=true on characters. Home = royal-blue/white, Away = burnt-orange/black. The star (home leader) is generated separately. priority 1 = essential, 2 = depth, 3 = nice-to-have.

defaults.negative_prompt: nike, adidas, reebok, NHL, real team logo, sponsor logo, brand name, watermark, signature, jersey number, text, lettering, blurry, deformed, disfigured, extra limbs, extra fingers, mannequin, plastic skin, smooth featureless face, cartoon, lowpoly, toy
